name: Suomen linnat (Finnish castles)
title: Suomen linnat (Finnish castles)
description: Catalog of Finnish castles (linnat) — medieval and post-medieval stone castles in Finland including Hämeen linna (Häme Castle, 13th c.), Olavinlinna (Olofsborg/Olaf's Castle, Savonlinna, 1475), Turun linna (Turku Castle, 13th c.), Kastelholman linna (Kastelholm, Åland), Raaseporin linna (Raseborg, Karjaa), Kajaanin linna (Kajaani, 17th c.), Oulun linna (Oulu), Kuusiston piispanlinna (Kuusisto Bishop's Castle), Viipurin linna (Vyborg Castle, now Russia), Käkisalmen linna (Kexholm/Priozersk, now Russia), Brahelinna, and ~25 other medieval-to-early-modern castles, hill-forts (linnavuoret/linnamäet), and bishop's residences. Extracted via fi.wikipedia categorymembers (Luokka:Suomen_linnat) cross-referenced with Wikidata. Each record includes multilingual names (34 languages), description in 12 languages, type/country/admin/location/owners properties resolved to 8 reference languages with QIDs, coordinates with fallback chain, inception year, image URL, Commons category, and Wikipedia sitelinks across 34 languages.
